description: For a finite first-order structure \(M\), let \(\sigma_M\) be the named covering sentence \(\forall y\,\bigvee_{a\in M}y=c_a\). The specified finite fragment \(\Gamma_M\) consists exactly of \(\sigma_M\) and all inequalities \(d\ne c_a\) for \(a\in M\), in the language with the old names and the additional constant \(d\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.exactFiniteObstruction.{u, v, w} (L : FirstOrder.Language) (M : Type w) [Finite M] :
  Finset (L.withConstants (Option M)).Sentence
